Dream's Dessert ( 1 Person)
By: J4nine
Published: Monday, February 21, 2011 - 12:51pm

Ingredients




1 Waffle (no sugar)
Vanilla Ice- Cream (optional flavour)
Melted Chocolate
3 Strawberries
4 halved almonds
Greek yoghurt

Preparation

1 Put a waffle on a plate 2 Put a scoop of ice cream on the waffle 3 Then add 2 tablespoons of greek yoghurt on top of the ice cream 4 Then add 3 strawberries on top 5 Surround the strawberries with the chopped almonds 6 Then add 3 teaspoons of melted chocolate on top

Comments:
J4nine

mmm ... it actually tastes yummy but it's very fatty
